[Pedagogy review · High priority · missing-prerequisite · pf-faf73860b3]
Sigma notation appears without an explanation of its bounds or their inclusive meaning.
Before p22-q7-root add: “The symbol Σ means add the terms obtained by substituting each integer k from the lower bound to the upper bound, including both ends. For example, Σ from k=3 to 5 of (2k+1)=7+9+11. There are 5−3+1=3 terms. The number of terms is upper bound−lower bound+1.”
Also affects: p22-q7-a, p22-q7-d
